# Synthetic AE Pilot Fixture

This fixture is synthetic-only and contains no real subject data.  It is the
P7-P1 baseline for proving an AE request can later be driven by governed Wiki
citations, Study context, deterministic gates, and controlled execution.

P7-P1 freezes input/output contracts only:

- no program is generated;
- no data transform is executed;
- no Wiki knowledge is modified;
- AEDECOD, Controlled Terminology, executable CRF/EDC mapping guidance, and
  study-specific AE decisions remain explicit gaps unless supplied by approved
  downstream context.
